Hi {{{Recipient.FirstName}}},
Welcome to the AK9I Family! We're thrilled to have you on board.
What's Next: 1. Phone Interview with Michelle 2. Acceptance Letter will be sent via email upon completion of phone interview. Please allow 3-5 business day for processing. 3. Submit the following:
- Highschool or College diploma/transcript or GED (only one of these items is required) - If using veteran's benefits, submit a copy of a Certificate of Eligibility or a Statement of Benefits - If using veteran's benefits, submit a copy of your Joint Service Transcript
mhartman@ak9i.com < mailto:mhartman@ak9i.com >
